papers.name: LaDiR
papers.title: LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Enhances LLMs for Text Reasoning
papers.question: Generate thoughts, then refine them.
papers.description: Encodes text reasoning into compact thought blocks and generates them with diffusion. Iterative denoising gives the model room to refine a thought before continuing.

papers.name: LaDi-RL
papers.title: LaDi-RL: Latent Diffusion Reasoning Prevents Entropy Collapse in Reinforcement Learning
papers.question: Explore in thought space.
papers.description: Optimizes a diffusion reasoning policy with reinforcement learning. Multiple text decodings of each latent trajectory help separate the quality of a thought from how it is expressed.

papers.name: Uni-LaDiR
papers.title: Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning
papers.question: Different evidence. One reasoning interface.
papers.description: Learns shared thoughts from text, images, 3D point clouds, and robot states through continuation prediction. A jointly trained diffusion reasoner generates the thoughts at test time.

papers.name: NF-CoT
papers.title: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows
papers.question: Continuous thoughts in a causal stream.
papers.description: Uses normalizing flows to sample latent thoughts alongside text in a causal language model. Exact likelihoods and KV-cache decoding connect continuous reasoning to familiar language-model tools.

papers.name: Scaffolding Minds
papers.title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning
papers.question: Learn what a visual thought should contain.
papers.description: Learns a dedicated encoder for useful visual targets, then learns both the mean and variance of a latent sampler. Representation learning and exploration work together.

papers.name: CLaRa
papers.title: CLaRa: Bridging Retrieval and Generation with Continuous Latent Reasoning
papers.question: Connect knowledge to the answer.
papers.description: Compresses documents into continuous representations and trains retrieval and generation together. A shared objective ties the knowledge selected by the retriever to the answer the model produces.

papers.name: SkillFM
papers.title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
papers.question: Generate guidance for an agent.
papers.description: Samples task-conditioned skills in a latent space with flow matching, then decodes them into textual guidance for a frozen agent. The latent object is a reusable skill, rather than an intermediate thought.

papers.name: LT²
papers.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers
papers.question: Make repeated computation affordable.
papers.description: Pairs looped transformers with linear or sparse attention. Repeated internal computation refines memory and expands context access without requiring a new text token at each iteration.

papers.name: PLANNER
papers.title: PLANNER: Generating Diversified Paragraph via Latent Language Diffusion Model
papers.question: Plan meaning before writing words.
papers.description: Combines diffusion over paragraph-level semantic representations with autoregressive text decoding. An earlier foundation for separating the generation of a latent plan from its expression in language.

papers.name: TarFlowLM
papers.title: Flexible Language Modeling in Continuous Space with Transformer-based Autoregressive Flows
papers.question: Model language in continuous space.
papers.description: Uses transformer-based normalizing flows for continuous language modeling, with flexible token blocks and multiple generation passes. A foundation for probabilistic models of latent states.
